components.name: Primary button
components.description: A source-derived primary action; preview only.
components.css: .ds-primary { font: 14px/1.5 "Oracle Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #312d2a); min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d4cfca); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; background: var(--accent, #bd4332); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); border-color: transparent; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--soft, #f1efed); } .ds-primary:active { background: var(--border, #d4cfca); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #bd4332); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-primary { transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #9b382a); }

components.name: Secondary button

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; color: var(--shell-text, #fbf9f8); background: var(--shell, #312d2a); } .ds-nav button { font: 14px/1.5 "Oracle Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #312d2a); min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d4cfca); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; color: inherit; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 8px; border-color: transparent; } .ds-nav svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav button:hover { background: var(--soft, #f1efed); } .ds-nav button:active { background: var(--border, #d4cfca); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #bd4332); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav button:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-nav button { transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } } .ds-nav button:hover { background: var(--shell-hover, #514c47); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--shell-warning, #ffd18c); }

components.name: Composer
components.description: The source input shell and Send primitive; application-populated attachments and task controls are omitted.
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; font: 14px/1.5 "Oracle Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #312d2a); background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #d4cfca); border-radius: var(--radius-surface, 12px); padding: 10px 12px; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--focus, #bd4332); outline: 1px solid var(--focus, #bd4332); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-composer textarea { font: inherit; color: inherit; resize: none; background: transparent; border: 0; width: 100%; min-height: 52px; max-height: 160px; padding: 6px 0 12px; caret-color: var(--accent, #bd4332); } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #6f6964); opacity: 1; } .ds-composer textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-composer-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-send { font: 14px/1.5 "Oracle Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #312d2a); min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d4cfca); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--accent, #bd4332); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); border: 0; width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 10px; } .ds-send svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; display: block; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-send:hover { background: var(--soft, #f1efed); } .ds-send:active { background: var(--border, #d4cfca); } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #bd4332); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-send:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-send { transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } } .ds-send:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #9b382a); }

components.name: History selection

components.css: .ds-history { font: 14px/1.5 "Oracle Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 8px; margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--text, #312d2a); background: var(--accent-soft, #ffebe8); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); } .ds-history button { font: 14px/1.5 "Oracle Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #312d2a); min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d4cfca); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; display: flex; text-align: left; width: 100%; border: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-history button > span { min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-history strong, .ds-preview { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-history strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-preview { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted, #6f6964); margin-top: 4px; } .ds-history button:hover { background: var(--soft, #f1efed); } .ds-history button:active { background: var(--border, #d4cfca); } .ds-history button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #bd4332); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-history button:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-history button { transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } }

narrative.overview:
AXIS uses the user-selected Oracle Redwood direction: warm neutral surfaces, a charcoal shell, and restrained red actions. The existing AXIS mark retains its geometry. The interface is compact and rectangular, with local sans typography and a consistent authored SVG stroke family.

Flat surfaces, readable text, and explicit state carry the interface. Shared controls and review patterns connect the side panel, full-tab settings, and approval popup. Capabilities remain available through progressive disclosure; visual simplification does not change task ownership, execution modes, or approval semantics.
keyCharacteristics: Warm light surfaces and an explicit charcoal dark theme.
Local sans typography with stronger leading for answers.
Small control corners, larger contained-surface corners, and restrained borders.
Authored SVG icons, labeled states, and visible keyboard focus.
Short functional motion that respects reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: Brand red identifies actions and emphasis; success, warning, and danger retain their separate semantic roles. Status is accompanied by text.

rules.name: The Local Type Rule
rules.body: Use the packaged local font stack. Do not add a remote font or a new display face to this product.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Ordinary content, controls, and cards remain flat. Floating action menus use the shared shadow; modal separation uses the shared backdrop.

dos: Do use semantic CSS variables so light, dark, and system appearance remain consistent across extension surfaces.
Do preserve the AXIS mark geometry and use the authored SVG family for interface icons.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, accessible names for icon controls, and text labels for status.
Do let long content wrap and expose scrollable approval details with a visible continuation cue.
Do keep native popover menus distinct from modal history and task-switch dialogs.
Do place live task controls in the single current-task strip and keep answers readable above collapsed activity.
donts: Don't add remote fonts, runtime design dependencies, ornamental gradients, or decorative animation.
Don't replace semantic success, warning, or danger colors with brand red.
Don't duplicate live Pause/Resume and Stop controls across the timeline and composer.
Don't truncate decision-critical approval values or substitute a generated summary for supplied data.
Don't convert the restrained control geometry into pill-shaped navigation or add shadows to ordinary cards.
